article.title: High John, Ole Massa and De Indigo Deer
article.author: Becca Rayehanatou Haynesworth
article.content: On one of them back break’n plantations down in the lowcountry is where John lived. Where field hands, from sun up to sun down, picked sea island cotton and rice sheafs till their hands bled numb. Read more via Scalawag : High John, Ole Massa and De Indigo Deer .
